Maryland writes the rate as 6 cents for each exact dollar of the taxable price, and taxes the part of a dollar over an exact dollar on a schedule of cents (1 cent when the excess is 1 to 16 cents, 2 cents for 17 to 33, and so on). This calculator approximates it as 6% of the price, so on a price with cents the tax Maryland collects can differ from the result by a cent or two.
